title: The Floating Market
text: Rafts lashed together in the fog, lantern-lit and swaying: a market of the drowned. Pale traders with weed in their hair sell things the marsh took, rings and boots and wedding veils and whole small boats. Their prices are fair. Their stalls drip.

options.label: Buy something the marsh took, and give it a second life.

outcomes.text: A drowned soldier's gear, cleaned, still smelling of the deep. It never quite dries.

options.label: The shrewdest haggles with the drowned, who have all the time in the world.

outcomes.text: A good price, and gossip, and wet coins in change.

options.label: The weakest swimmer stays on the shore, rather than risk the rafts.

outcomes.text: The rafts drift off into the fog while they wait. They are alone a long while, and the marsh talks to them.
